affected_party: QIF users, reviewers, auditors, and AI agents applying v0.2 runtime packages
actual_problem: QIF v0.2 is executable, but reusable applicability rules are conflated with target-specific decisions, extraction traceability is implicit, governance triggers are not first-class, and verifier scope can be misread as semantic truth.
why_it_matters: The runtime must be auditable and domain-general; ambiguity in selection, extraction, or verifier authority would make review results hard to reproduce or govern.
why_now: v0.2 has just been released, so hardening the model before larger corpora or integrations prevents unstable concepts from spreading.
